svg.title: One pass, one retry, and the retry was almost never needed
svg.desc: The authenticated handoff is rendered deterministically into one prompt for GPT-5.6 Sol, which runs at medium reasoning with strict structured output and a 12,000-token ceiling. Sol returns an answer object, which local code checks for the exact topic and narrative, the required metadata, the answer structure, unique references, the allowed citation domain, the exact-hint citation rules and the 1,024-word ceiling. A pass publishes; a rejection buys exactly one more attempt and no more. Below, a strip of 119 marks stands for the 119 topics, and only two of them are filled: two topics used the second attempt. The accepted file took 121 Sol calls, and its answers run from 203 to 749 words with 10 to 40 references.
svg.text: One pass, one retry, and the retry was almost never needed
one more attempt, and no more
How often that second attempt was used:
119 topics · 2 used the second attempt · 121 Sol calls in all
Answers run from 203 to 749 words with 10 to 40 references.
